head_commit.message:
RV02: pin exact values in system-variable, profile, EXECUTE and lint tests

System variables: fresh-session telemetry, no spill for an in-memory GROUP BY,
one miss then three hits for a cached subquery. eng.profile: the profiled
statement and its row count. EXECUTE: the bound parameter values and the @p
placeholders the source receives, including reversed ?2/?1 (the mock ignores
WHERE, so the old temp-table checks never saw binding). Lint: the exact four
findings, and a sort test whose findings are not already in order.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01GLm6xGfL8xFAdYuHc3qLwD
